title: feat(react): an action's params values are templates, evaluated where properties are
body:
Fixes #7867
Clause-②: yes

## What this does

Ruling A on the card (comment `5749025615`, maintainer 「其他同意」): **an action's `params` values are templates, evaluated where `properties` are.** Every string leaf of a node's `params` bag - the node-level `params` and `properties.params` alike, at any depth, inside nested objects and arrays - is now template-evaluated in the `SchemaRenderer` evaluation memo, with the same evaluator and scope that already evaluates `properties`. A metadata-authored `navigate_edit` button on a record page can name the record it sits on with `"recordId": "${record.id}"`.

## Measured, before and after

Through the real `SchemaRenderer` -> real `action:button` -> real `ActionRunner`, on a record page bound by `RecordContextProvider` to `{ id: 'rec_1' }`, with `navigate_edit` registered as a handler. Values read off the `ActionDef` the handler received.

| case | base `142fdfd8` | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| CONTROL `properties.label: "L-${record.id}"` | `L-rec_1` | `L-rec_1` |
| CASE A node-level `params.recordId: "${record.id}"` | raw `${record.id}` | `rec_1` |
| CASE B `properties.params.recordId` | raw `${record.id}` | `rec_1` |
| two levels down (object and array) | raw | `rec_1` |
| unresolvable `${nope.id}` | raw at handler, not reported | raw at handler, reported once as `params.recordId` |

The base column is the new pin file run on the unmodified tree: 4 failed, 1 passed (the CONTROL).

## Design

- **One rule, one place.** `evaluateConfigValue(key, value)` is defined once inside the memo that already evaluates `properties`: a `params` bag has every string leaf evaluated; every other value evaluates exactly as before (per-value, shallow, CEL predicate envelope preserved). No second evaluator.
- **Three carriers call it.** Node-level `params` was not seen by the memo at all on base (it evaluated only `content`, the bindable text keys, `properties`, `props` and the condition keys), so it is routed into the same memo through the same function, before the hoist. `properties.params` goes through it inside the `properties` loop, before the hoist, so the hoisted `schema.params` and `schema.properties.params` agree. `props.params` goes through it in the legacy-alias loop, so the two bag loops do not disagree about a key (the objectui#5123 / objectui#9100 precedent). Each authored value is evaluated exactly once.
- **The walk** lives in a new module, `packages/react/src/utils/paramsBag.ts`, which the unevaluated-expression diagnostic also uses, so what is evaluated and what is reported as left unresolved are one radius by construction.
- **What the walk does not look inside:** an ARRAY `params` (the `ActionParam[]` definition list `action:button` routes to `actionParams`, whose members carry deferred predicates such as `visible`, `titleFormat` and option `visibleWhen`) is left as authored; keys are never evaluated; non-plain objects (`Date`, `Map`, class instances) and functions pass through by identity; a container already on the current path (a cycle in a host-built bag) is passed through unwalked. An envelope-shaped object inside the bag is walked, not collapsed to its `source`. Copy on write: the authored bag is never mutated. The plain-object test is built on `isConfigBag` (the objectui#6761 one-spelling pin stays green).
- **The diagnostic** (`utils/unevaluatedExpression.ts`) walks `params` leaves with the same walker and names a finding by its path (`params.recordId`, `properties.params.target.id`). Its channel enumeration now names `params` too - otherwise an author whose `params` template threw would be told `params` is not a channel at all, the objectui#7849 defect one channel later.
- **Docs:** the note PR objectui#7865 added to `content/docs/guide/record-edit-modes.md` returns to teaching `"recordId": "${record.id}"`, and says what happens when a template cannot be evaluated (raw text plus the dev diagnostic) and that a misspelled field on a bound record resolves to nothing (both measured).
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/react` minor, behaviour change stated.

## Blast radius

- Authored `params` bags in this repository carrying a literal `${`: none. Measured once on `142fdfd8` with a one-off scanner over every tracked json/ts/tsx/js/jsx/mjs/md/mdx/yaml/yml file (CHANGELOGs excluded), matching quoted and unquoted `params` keys followed by an object or array and reading the balanced block; its only hit is a JavaScript template literal in app-shell code, not metadata. Controls: the doc's two `params` bags matched, and the card's CASE A / CASE B spellings matched. Nothing re-derives this reading; it is a historical measurement, not a live count.
- In-tree renderers reading a node-level `params`: `action:button` and `action:icon`. `action:group` / `action:menu` read `params` off their own `actions` items, which do not pass through the memo.

## Boundary, measured and not changed here

`action:bar` mounts its members directly through the component registry, not through `SchemaRenderer`, so neither `properties` nor `params` of a member passes through the memo: a member with `params.recordId: "${record.id}"` on the same record page reached the handler raw. The ruling's own statement ("evaluated where `properties` are") holds there, since a member's `properties` are not evaluated either. Raised with the dispatching seat; `action-bar.tsx` is outside this card's surface.

## Tests

New pins:

- `packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-params-templates-7867.test.tsx` (5): CONTROL, CASE A, CASE B, two levels down, unresolvable still reports. Lives in `@object-ui/components` because it drives the real `action:button` and runner.
- `packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.paramsTemplates-7867.test.tsx` (18): the three carriers, what the walk does not touch (array params, keys, non-plain objects, a `source`-keyed bag, cycles, no mutation, other nested keys stay shallow), the diagnostic's path and radius, copy on write.

Union at `c5cbe18d` (final HEAD): `packages/react/` whole, `packages/components/src/renderers/action/`, the components action / page-header-action suites, `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-expression-carriage.test.ts`, `scripts/__tests__/check-component-surface-parity.test.ts`, `packages/layout/src/__tests__/guide-layout-app-shell-doc.test.ts`: **122 files, 1666 tests passed**. `@object-ui/react` `type-check` green at `c5cbe18d`; `@object-ui/components` `type-check` green (its reading of `@object-ui/react` is the built public surface, which no commit after the build changed). `scripts/__tests__/` 178 passed, 2 skipped (at `02a2fb45`).

Ablation (at `02a2fb45`; `c5cbe18d` changes one docblock only), through `ablation-replace.mjs` with the anchor proven to land (anchor 1 -> 0, replacement 0 -> 1) and the restore proven on disk (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import `@object-ui/react` through the vitest source alias, so the mutated source is what they run.

- Leg 1, memo shallow for `params` again (the `params` branch of `evaluateConfigValue` disabled): **12 red** - CASE A, CASE B and the two-levels-down pin, plus 9 react pins (carriers, keys, non-plain, `source` bag, cycle, no-mutation); CONTROL, the array pin, the other-keys-stay-shallow pin and the unresolvable pins stay green. Direction as predicted before the run.
- Leg 2, the diagnostic's `params` walk disabled: **3 red** - the e2e "unresolvable still reports" pin and the two react diagnostic pins; everything else green. As predicted.

Gates run locally: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check-doc-expression-carriage` (report-only), `check-doc-component-types`, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-doc-links`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:spec-symbols`, targeted ESLint on the changed source and test files (0 errors), all green.

NOT MEASURED locally: `check-doc-snippet-types` and `check-doc-example-types` (they need a 34-package scoped build; this diff adds no ts/tsx fence and no `@example`). Left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- `check-doc-expression-carriage`'s hit text says `SchemaRenderer` evaluates "exactly four channels"; `params` leaves are now a fifth. The census reads only top-level string values, so it neither counts nor misjudges a nested `params` template. Report-only; not changed here.
- Two findings outside this card went to the dispatching seat rather than into this PR: `UIActionSchema.params` is declared `ActionParam[]`-only while the runtime and the guide use an object `params` bag; and a `properties` value that is an object with a string `source` key (for example `properties.bodyExtra`) is collapsed to that string by the shallow loop.
- Open PR objectui#10271 (the params-dialog carry-over) works on the array `params` definition path, which this PR leaves untouched; no file overlaps with any open PR.
- The depth-1 qualification comment on objectui#7849 is the claiming seat's, not made here.
